svg.title: TTA Notifications v0.6 — Out-of-band subscription (source-initiated), receiver bootstrap and mode enforcement

g.text: TTA Notifications v0.6 — Out-of-band subscription (source-initiated), receiver bootstrap and mode enforcement
Step 1: the sender decides the partner should be informed
but defines no transaction for it
Step 2: handshake reaches a subscription the receiver never created
POC: looks up a basis registered via
Alternative: ask the knooppunt PDP against the PIP's
local consent record — same hook, different source
topic in agreed list AND mode in allowed modes
"payload mode outside the exchange agreement — handshake refused"
this subscription are rejected the same way
Step 3: events flow exactly as in the in-band case
identical inbox shape — the vendor cannot tell
